name: Bug Trio
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/temple-of-ahnqiraj/bug-trio.md. The engine has one boss, so the three bugs are three phases of one boss in the standard kill order Kri > Yauj > Vem: HP is a clock over 210 s (real values are unknown, Wowhead shows 'Seasonal 40 Player' only and Era pools may be lower). ESTIMATES: the room is a 46 yd round chamber with named alcoves, phase lengths (80, 70, 60 s) and the Yauj Brood count (4 adds, real count unknown) are placeholders. The boss's melee is one value (800 per 2 s, under the wiki's ~1,000 because Cleave and Volley add to it) for all three bugs, so Kri's Thrash and Yauj's Ravage are folded into it; a 10,000 HP tank lives on the raid's passive healing and is lost inside 30 s if a player healer ignores him (only 140 per second of healing). Kill order: Kri first while Yauj (a `killable`, non-priority add parked in her alcove; hits on her score `attacksOnAdds`) and Vem (an add the off-tank holds, not attackable) wait. Each change of target is a `threatWipe` with `teleportBossTo` at the next phase start, the player tank walks to the next bug and Taunts. In the real fight three tank teams hold their own bugs; here the tank role follows the kill order instead. Yauj's real Great Heal also dispels and heals the other two bugs if they are in her line of sight, and Vem can devour Kri's corpse: neither is simulated, so the instruction to keep them apart is tips only. Summon Player is not modelled. Toxic Volley: 450 direct as an `aoe` plus three separate poison debuffs of 16 s (75 per second each, the 150 per 2 s of spell data) on random raiders, the engine's stand-in for 'cleanse every global' since `target: all` cannot put a debuff on the whole raid. Its 8 to 35 s DBM spread is modelled as 22 s with 8 s of jitter. Fear (DBM 20.3 to 29.4 s) is 8 s; the real spell hits everyone within 45 yd (this room), but `playerChance` 0.4 stands in for Tremor Totem and Fear Ward coverage, and only non-tanks can be hit since the tank roles are assumed to have Fear Ward, Tremor Totem or Berserker Rage. A separate `threatWipe` models her aggro loss. Great Heal's 69,375 is not simulated (a heal has no effect on the health clock), so `completedMetric` is the cost: 2 s cast, interruptible, Yauj casting (`offBoss`) while Kri is the target. Kri's Toxic Vapors cloud is an 8 yd `hazard` at his death spot with 2,000 tick damage for 120 s, modelled at phase 2's first moment (no telegraph is real). Vem's Berserker Charge is a 2,400 `debuff` with `stun: 2` on a random non-tank (`playerChance` 0.3), since the LoS rule cannot be expressed. Knock Away is a frontal `knockback` on the tank. Vengeance is Vem's death effect on any surviving bugs (wiki, Wowhead, cmangos emulator). It is not simulated because this kill order never reaches it: Vem dies last. What phase 3 models is the separate Wowhead claim that Vem goes berserk when he is the last bug alive (`vemBerserk`, at the start of phase 3). That claim has a single source and cmangos has no such spell, so it could not be verified. Its strength is unknown: `enrageMultiplier` 1.4 is a placeholder, scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play and an idle healer still loses him fast. If the raid killed Vem first, Vengeance would land on Kri or Yauj; that order is not simulated. Vem's Knockdown on his tank (2 s stun every 15 to 20 s) comes from cmangos only and is not in the wiki or Wowhead text. A 15 minute hard enrage is in the research but the fight here is 3.5 minutes, so it is never reached.

tankVem.label: Tank Vem, back to the wall

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Follow the kill order: Kri first facing north, then Yauj, then Vem. Each one is a new target with an empty threat table, so Taunt the moment she or he arrives. Yauj's Fear wipes her threat: Taunt her back the moment it goes out.

offtank.label: Vem and Brood tank
offtank.description: Your job is Vem and then Yauj's Brood. Hold Vem in his alcove facing the wall with your back to it. When Yauj dies, catch the Brood before they reach the raid.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stay behind whichever bug is the target. Kick Great Heal. When Kri dies, leave his cloud immediately. Do not hit the wrong bug.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Same target as the melee, from range. Kick Great Heal. Stay out of where Kri's cloud will land.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Toxic Volley is the fight. Cleanse every global, heal the tank through the hand-offs, and expect to be feared every twenty-odd seconds.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Cleanse poison
dispel.tip: Cure Poison, Abolish Poison or Cleanse. Removes one Toxic Volley poison from the raid.

interrupt.label: Interrupt
interrupt.tip: Kick, Pummel, Shield Bash or Counterspell on Great Heal. Yauj is immune to Silence, so it has to be a real interrupt.

cleave.label: Cleave
cleave.tip: Kri cleaves whoever stands in front of him. Only the tank belongs there.

toxicVolley.label: Toxic Volley
toxicVolley.tip: Instant, the whole room, and it stacks. Cleanse it off the raid.

toxicDot.label: Toxic Volley poison
toxicDot.tip: Poison that stacks if it is left on you.

yaujFear.label: Fear
yaujFear.tip: Eight seconds, instant, the whole room. Tanks are assumed to have Fear Ward or Tremor Totem.

yaujFearFar.label: Fear (from Yauj)
yaujFearFar.tip: Yauj fears the room while you are on Kri. Tanks are assumed to have Fear Ward or Tremor Totem.

yaujWipe.label: Yauj wipes her threat
yaujWipe.toast: Fear wiped her threat. Tank, Taunt her!
yaujWipe.tip: Her threat table resets when she fears, even if the fear itself is warded.

greatHeal.label: Great Heal (Yauj)
greatHeal.tip: Two second cast on a bug about 13 seconds apart. Kick it. If it lands she heals for thousands.

greatHealSelf.label: Great Heal
greatHealSelf.tip: Two second cast. Kick it before it heals her.

kriCloud.label: Toxic Vapors
kriCloud.tip: Kri dies and leaves a two minute cloud at 2,000 per second. Get out now and never walk back through it.

yaujPickup.label: Yauj is next
yaujPickup.toast: Kri is dead. Yauj next: tank, take her.
yaujPickup.tip: Kri is down. Yauj's tank team takes her, the raid switches.

vemPickup.label: Vem is next
vemPickup.toast: Yauj is dead. Vem next: tank, take him.
vemPickup.tip: Yauj is down and her Brood are loose. Vem is the last target.

vemBerserk.label: Berserk
vemBerserk.toast: Vem is the last one left: he berserks!
vemBerserk.tip: Vem goes berserk when he is the last bug alive. Tank and healers, this is the part that needs your big cooldowns.

vemKnockdown.label: Knockdown
vemKnockdown.tip: Vem knocks his tank down for two seconds.

vemCharge.label: Berserker Charge
vemCharge.tip: Vem charges someone he can see, knocks them down for two seconds and hits like a truck.

knockAway.label: Knock Away
knockAway.tip: Vem knocks his tank back. Against the wall it does nothing.

vemAdd.label: Vem
vemAdd.tip: Vem is the off-tank's job until he is the last one left.

yaujDummy.label: Princess Yauj (not yet)
yaujDummy.tip: Yauj waits in her alcove with her own tanks. She is not the target yet.

yaujBrood.label: Yauj Brood
yaujBrood.tip: Her Brood swarms out when she dies. Off-tank grabs them, casters AoE them.

expectations.label: Pull Kri to the west side, facing north
expectations.tip: Keep his front off the raid and off the melee. Remember where he dies: you will be leaving that spot in a hurry.

expectations.label: Stand clear of where Kri will die
expectations.tip: Stack near the entrance. His cloud lands where he dies and you are not going to be there.

expectations.label: Pick up Vem
expectations.tip: Run him into his alcove, back against the wall, facing the wall. Nobody should be in his line of sight.

expectations.label: Hold Vem in his alcove
expectations.tip: Back to the wall so Knock Away does nothing. Do not walk him into the raid or Kri's cloud.

expectations.label: Stay out of Kri's front
expectations.tip: Cleave and Thrash hit anyone in front of him. Stand behind him the whole time.

expectations.label: Kill Kri first, then Yauj, then Vem
expectations.tip: Kri's poison is what kills the raid. He goes first, Yauj second, Vem last. Do not spread your damage onto the wrong bug.

expectations.label: Stay on Kri
expectations.tip: Yauj heals and fears the raid but she is not the target yet. Every hit on her is wasted until Kri is dead.

expectations.label: Yauj never finishes a Great Heal
expectations.tip: Two second cast every thirteen seconds. Kick it, rotate with the other interrupts.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Clear the Toxic Volley poison
expectations.tip: It stacks if you leave it. Cleanse every global until the raid is clean.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Kri's Thrash spikes. Top up after every Cleave and every volley.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Over half before the next Fear. If you get feared you cannot save him.

expectations.label: Yauj in her alcove
expectations.tip: Far away from Vem so she cannot dispel or heal him.

expectations.label: Taunt Yauj the moment she fears
expectations.tip: Fear wiped her table. Whoever taunts first keeps her in her alcove; if she runs she is on the raid.

expectations.label: Leave the cloud where Kri died
expectations.tip: Two thousand a second, eight yards wide. If you are in it you have seconds. Everyone moves, now.

expectations.label: Keep Vem in his alcove
expectations.tip: Back to the wall, facing the wall. The raid is about to move across the room, so hold him where you are.

expectations.label: She never finishes a Great Heal
expectations.tip: Same deal on the target as off it: two seconds, kick it.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: New target, new tank spot. Keep him high through the hand-off.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Over half before the next Fear. If you get feared you cannot save him.

expectations.label: Take Vem the moment Yauj is down
expectations.tip: Run over and Taunt. He comes with a full threat wipe and his Berserk is about to land.

expectations.label: Hold Vem facing the wall
expectations.tip: Back to the wall so Knock Away cannot move you. He is the kill target now, so the raid is in his sight and his charges will land.

expectations.label: Pick up the Brood
expectations.tip: They run for the raid. Catch them near the middle and hold them while the casters AoE them.

expectations.label: Hold the Brood in the middle
expectations.tip: Stay between them and the raid until they are dead.

expectations.label: Kill the Brood, then Vem
expectations.tip: The Brood are on the raid. Clear them quickly, then everything into Vem.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: New target, new tank spot. Keep him high through the hand-off.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Over half before the next Fear. If you get feared you cannot save him.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds loose on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

healsLanded.label: Great Heals that finished
healsLanded.tip: Kick her heal the moment it starts.

attacksOnAdds.label: Attacks on the wrong bug
attacksOnAdds.tip: Yauj is not the target yet. Face Kri and stay on him.

cues.notes: Kick Great Heal on the bar; cleanse every poison; Taunt each new bug.

list.label: Taunt when the bug turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Kick Great Heal
list.tip: Two second cast from Yauj. Kick it.

list.label: Kick Great Heal
list.tip: Yauj is the target now and she still heals. Kick it.

list.label: Dispel it
list.tip: Cleanse Toxic Volley poison every global until the raid is clean.

list.label: Pick up the Brood
list.tip: Catch them before they reach the raid.

drills.name: Yauj Fear and the Taunt back
drills.description: Fear wipes her table every 14 s. Taunt her back and stay in melee.

drills.name: Kick the heal
drills.description: Great Heal every 9 s, Kick it inside the two-second cast.

drills.name: Leave the cloud
drills.description: A cloud lands on the boss's spot every 16 s, just like Kri's death. Melee out, then back in.

drills.name: Catch the Brood
drills.description: Four Brood every 18 s. Grab them and hold them for the casters.

drills.name: Toxic Volley
drills.description: Volleys come every 9 s, three poisons each. Cleanse every global and keep the tank up.

limitations: The three bosses share one encounter track. Kill order does not select their death effects or the remaining abilities.
